strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 10 turns
...I'd like to stop at Anaheim Electronics for the new weapon...
Is that okay? Weren't we short on time!?
We don't have much leeway... but we have a little.
It's pointless unless we break through the colony's enemy guard.
...Failure isn't an option.
Better safe than sorry, huh?
Geez, Quattro sounded so serious, I wondered what would happen.
Looks like we've got plenty of time.
Yeah, that's a relief.
Looks like it'll go fine. Aren't you worrying too much, Lieutenant?
Maybe we were overthinking it.
You scared us for nothin', I tell ya.
...I wonder.
Lieutenant?
If I were them, I'd hold the enemy here. In which case...
No waaay!?
Fast as ever, Londo Bell.
But for Operation Stardust to succeed... I can't let you act now!
An enemy attack!?
Th-That's...! The Gundam GP02A...!
The bulky Gundam that got stolen!?
If I remember right... it has a nuke!
The crazy Gundam armed with a nuclear Bazooka!?
Don't tell me they mean to blow up the whole city...!
Just when we're about to head out!
As I thought... by the book. Captain, I'm going out.
I'm going too!
Tch, nothing goes right. Talk about bad timing.
True. We're on the back foot, too...!
If only we'd headed for the colony sooner...
You should say Zeon simply moved faster.
If they drop the colony, it's a huge blow to the Federation Forces,
plus a threat to those invaders crawling out from underground.
Two birds with one stone for Zeon.
Like hell we'll let 'em do that!
Captain Bright, do we still have time!?
...Ten minutes! We can't spare any more than that!
Ten minutes!? You've got to be kidding! What do we do!?
Whaddaya mean? We just gotta do it, right, Sis Yuki?
We have to keep pushing forward...
Heh, even if it's reckless, all we can do is Rush in.
...So they've come out. All according to plan so far... Good, attack!
Gato!
Hmph, who are you?
Why did you steal Unit 2!?
I have no words for the likes of you! A man who can't grasp why he fights!
Fighting for many people, to protect my homeland...
You're saying that means nothing!? Gatooo!
...Heh, you've grown quite bold...!
Answer me, Gato!
Those without ideals, without convictions, have no tomorrow...!
A pilot fighting alone won't change the world!
The proof... aside from you, the Federation can barely lift a finger!
That's...
People who need others' help even to defend their own homeland...
Can they survive!? A man who fights as a cog could never understand!
...Maybe so! But I'll keep chasing you until we settle this...!
It seems our values are simply different...!
Hm!? That move! Charging right inside my guard...!
...Major Anavel Gato.
A contact line...!? Who are you!
What you... no, what Zeon sought, the ideals it raised...
all of it ended back then.
When Zeon Zum Deikun was assassinated by the Zabi family...!
...!! You... no, you're... Colonel!?
Lieutenant! Captain Quattro! What are you doing!?
...He's opened a contact line? Why...!?
Think again. The Zabis are merely using the name of Zeon.
And so is Haman Karn...!
Ngh...! Colonel, even so... I am a soldier of Zeon!
For the many fallen heroes trampled
by the fools of the Federation... I cannot back down...!
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Crap! Enemy reinforcements!?
Hey, wait! Didn't they just come out of the city!? What's going on!?
Lieutenant? Captain Kelly Layzner!
I've waited for this moment! Lying low so long was worth it...!
I'll cover you!
Thank you, Lieutenant Colonel Cima! For arranging everything up to now...
Oh, I don't need thanks in words. It means nothing without results.
...That's... the Gerbera Tetra...!? The one from before...!
A new model and... what's that? A pretty old mobile suit.
Enemy troops inside...! They knew we'd have the city at our backs...
Well done, Nightmare of Solomon...!
This is no time for compliments, Quattro!
Now we're in a real pinch.
It's gotta be like this...! Otherwise it's no fun!
Tetsuya, are you all right!?
Heh, making some big dramatic entrance! Doesn't matter to me!
Let's go!
We can't dawdle in a place like this!
This... looks pretty rough.
There's no time! Push it if you must! Take them out one by one!
So many enemies... This is pretty tough.
Having more of 'em doesn't make 'em better.
Quit your grumbling!
...They do outnumber us, though.
Natural, if stalling us is their goal... but we can't afford to say that.
Right!? So what do we do?
It's all over... Forget stalling, I'll finish you off right here...!
Shame you might not get to see the colony fall, though... Hehehe.
You bastard! Running your mouth like that!
Fujiwara! Don't take the bait!
Easy for you to say! Dammit!
I can't say I don't get how Fujiwara feels, dammit!
Heh... However hard you push yourselves as individuals,
you're just ants challenging an elephant. Too bad.
Kenrou! Grant me the thunder of justice!
Brother! They're being held up, just like we thought!
You're helping us again!?
I'd rather not stick my nose into other star systems' squabbles.
But if Gyandlar's moving behind the scenes... that's another story.
Surely not... with Zeon...!?
No, not at all. I don't think the other side has even noticed.
Working in the shadows... is that it? I can't see their real aim.
It seems they plan to use the chaos of the colony drop to descend to Earth.
So they want to exploit our mess. How nasty.
So we've got the same goal in the end. Count on you, heroes of justice!
Leave it to us! All right! Rom, let's go all out!
Don't get carried away, Drill. But yes, that's how it is...
Nothing personal... but you'll be rust on the Tenku Shinken.
What are you babbling about!
What can five little machines do!
In battle, size is not what matters...!
No, I can't take more damage...! When did they gather this much strength?
...I'll withdraw! All that's left is to see Stardust through...!
Gato!
We drove off the scariest one. The rest are small fry, right?
Hope so. Anyway, let's hurry, Roll!
Yeah, I know! Let's go!
He still had strength left... A formidable enemy.
He just ran away. Fight to the bitter end, I say.
But if you die, there's nothing you can do...
A man fights until his machine can't move. I don't like it.
Mobile suits aren't that sturdy, though.
No... this Delaz Fleet, a detached Zeon force,
knows when to pull back... Their kind is the most troublesome.
Anyway, we need to deal with the remaining enemies quickly...
Lieutenant Emma is right. Move, even a minute, even a second faster!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
All right, have we wiped out the enemy in this airspace!?
Looks like we're clear.
But we took quite a beating.
The Ra Cailum will now pursue the colony headed for Earth!
All units, return to the ship!
Huh? What about repairs and resupply?
We only have the supplies we loaded before leaving!
Repair and tune up damaged units while we're under way!
A forced march, huh...
Reckless. Reminds me of you back in the day, Rom.
No, it's not easy to do that while leading an organization...
It shows how capable this unit's leader is.
Brother, what do we do now?
...Next, Gyandlar and the Bunker should move directly. We'll stop them.
So you're leaving again after all? Why don't you just...
No. To judge those who move in the shadows...
we must become shadows ourselves...
An eye for an eye, huh?
I don't intend to stop you, nor do I have the right...
But won't you tell me your name? I am Quattro Bajeena.
...Rom Stol. Of Planet Cronos...
Weren't we short on time? Let's go, Rom!
...Then, farewell. May Kenrou guide you all as well.
So cool~
Planet Cronos...
Let's ask Dr. Tarsan.
That old geezer's been up to no good all over, so he might know.
Still, that's encouraging. People are helping us from the shadows.
We can't rely on that entirely.
All right, we can't waste the time they bought us!
We pursue the colony!
